1921 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100, so leap year? Actually 1921 ÷ 4 = 480.25, not divisible by 4, so not leap year).  
Days in months before March 1921: Jan 31, Feb 28.  
Start: 1921-12-01. Subtract 1 day → 1921-11-30.  
Subtract 30 more days → 1921-10-31.  
Now 210 total subtracted so far: 1 + 30 = 31 days. Need 210 total, so 179 days left.  

From Oct 31 backward:

Sep: 30 days → Sep 1 (total 91).  
Aug: 31 days → Aug 1 (total 122).  
Jul: 31 days → Jul 1 (total 153).  
Jun: 30 days → Jun 1 (total 183).  
We have overshot: need 210 total, we have used 183 from start, so need 27 more days back from Jun 1.  
From Jun 1 back 27 days: May has 31 days, so May 1 back 1 day → Apr 30 (1 day), back 26 more days into April: Apr 30 → Apr 4 (since 30 - 26 = 4).
